camel_example: aliyun hbr EnableBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --PlanId 'plan-000000000000000000000' --SourceType ECS_FILE --VaultId 'v-000000000000000000000' --Edition STANDARD
kebab_example: aliyun hbr enable-backup-plan --plan-id plan-000000000000000000000 --vault-id v-000000000000000000000 --source-type ECS_FILE --edition STANDARD --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: Backs up ECS files.

OSS: Backs up Alibaba Cloud OSS.

NAS: Backs up Alibaba Cloud NAS
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：

ECS_FILE：表示备份ECS文件
OSS：表示备份阿里云OSS
NAS：表示备份阿里云NAS
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The edition. Valid values are BASIC and STANDARD. The default value is STANDARD
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型，支持BASIC和STANDARD，默认值为STANDARD
parameters.name: edition
